messages:
Sam L.: FYI detection fired 03:12 UTC — anomalous S3 access + unusual API calls. We contained by disabling the svc acct token and blocked external egress. Need concise post-incident action list: RBAC, KMS, audit retention, vuln triage, comms, tabletop. :eyes:
Claire (oncall): Good catch. I followed containment runbook, took snapshots of instances and logs, and saved forensic artifacts to the case folder. Need owners for each item. :thumbsup:
Jackson: I'll own RBAC changes. Plan: revoke current tokens, narrow svcacct permissions from s3:* to s3:GetObject on specific prefixes, and add temporary deny for PutObject. Will open infra ticket and include rollback steps. ETA: today.
Maya: I recommend forced KMS key rotation for keys used by that svcacct. Also rotate any HSM/KMS client creds that may have been cached. Need to confirm whether any ciphertexts were exported.
Devon: I'll start vuln triage on the runtime image used by that service. Quick scan shows an outdated libcrypto version — will validate exploitability and prepare a rebuild pipeline patch.
Priya: For audit/logging: run this query and preserve the partitions — do not compact/purge until forensics sign-off: ```sql
SELECT * FROM access_logs WHERE principal='svc-account@example.com' AND ts >= '2026-03-19T00:00:00Z'
ORDER BY ts ASC;
```
Sam L.: Maya owns KMS rotation? Claire owns evidence/forensics? Devon owns vuln triage & rebuild? Jackson owns RBAC ticket? Priya owns audit retention change? I'll draft comms.
Maya: I can own KMS rotation. High-level ETA: 2-4 hours for rotation + verification, maybe longer if rewrap batch is large. Will post a runbook snippet here.
Claire (oncall): I'll take forensic capture & RCA draft. Will need Legal looped for communications review. Who should be on the RCA? Product, Infra, SecOps, and Customer Ops.
legal-bot: Please include data-scoping questions in the RCA: any PI exposure? logs shared with third parties? retention/notification obligations. Draft comms will need legal review before external-facing messaging.
Priya: Add an item to backlog: increase access_logs retention to 180 days for buckets marked sensitive and ensure audit log immutability for critical key actions (KMS: GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, Disable).
Jackson: RBAC diff: I'll remove wildcard s3 permissions and add least-privilege policy for the service. Will also add a canary policy change and monitor for failures for 1 hour before full cutover.
Devon: For vuln triage: confirmed libcrypto 1.1.0 -> propose upgrade to 3.x, rebuild base image, run regression tests. I'll queue a PR and tag CI to prioritize.
Sam L.: Comms: initial assessment shows no user data egress detected so far. Draft internal comms + postmortem for Trust page if verification holds. Legal/PR to review.
Priya: Operational note: do not disable alerts globally; set suppression window tied to the incident timeline only after we verify no replay attempts. Also snapshot the alerting rules that fired.
Maya: KMS rotation plan (sketch): 1) create new key version, 2) test rewrap on small batch, 3) rewrap all ciphertexts, 4) update secret versions and config, 5) retire old key after 72h and verification. I'll author runbook and checklist.
Claire (oncall): Let's schedule a tabletop next week to walk the detection -> containment -> comms timeline and validate playbooks. Proposed: Wed 10:00am PT. Invitees: Eng, Infra, SecOps, Legal, Customer Ops, DevEx.
Jackson: ACK Wed 10:00. I'll prepare RBAC diff and rollback doc.
Sam L.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the incident ticket with owners and deadlines. Action summary: KMS rotation (Maya), RBAC tighten + tokens revoked (Jackson), forensic capture & RCA (Claire), vuln triage & rebuild (Devon), audit retention & immutability (Priya), comms draft (Sam/legal). :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Action items recorded: INC-2026-1375. Please update the case as tasks progress.
